extraction: Loop design goal framework: goal must be machine-decidable. Template: 'Achieve <metric> <operator> <threshold> on <scope> by <deadline>'. Our Engine loop goal: 'Achieve CER < target on all 18 Indic scripts by campaign end'. Decidable: yes (CER measurable). Our fix-loop goal: 'Achieve CER reduction > 0 on target script by round 2'. Decidable: yes. Our validation call goal: 'Decide W6 training go/no-go by H48'. NOT machine-decidable — human judgment. Loop-design-check allows human judgment gate.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether loop goals machine-decidable (Engine, fix-loop) vs human judgment (validation call)
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
